testMechanism.negativeControl: Replace canonical-wins evaluation with top-level-first selection or a divergent-authority conflict refusal. The fixture must either no-op or emit the forbidden conflict diagnostic instead of the required horizontal-plan diagnostic.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Plan depth is a command-line artifact guard result.

scenarios.title: Canonical shallow graph wins over legacy deep graph

testMechanism.negativeControl: Swap the canonical and legacy arrays. The verdict must follow the new canonical graph.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Remove the top-level fallback. The legacy over-depth fixture must expose the compatibility loss.

scenarios.title: Execution scope progress is not authority

testMechanism.negativeControl: Insert execution.scopeProgress before certification in the authority chain. The conflicting execution graph must change the verdict and fail the regression.

liveProofNotApplicable.reason: Control-plane authority selection is a command-line contract.
